verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's own CLI documents batch operations over many files at once: wildcard conversion (`--convert-to pdf ... *.doc`), batch print-to-file, printing a list of files with `--pt`, and `--cat` text dumps, all runnable headless. A community user confirms running it in Docker to generate PDFs and normalize document formats at scale. Missing for 10: documented bulk operations beyond convert/print/extract (e.g., batch edits or find-replace across many documents without writing macros or UNO code), and independent evidence of large-batch reliability.
